worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter0_set.5: The one who stands before you is know as The Scourge, he is evil incarnate, in this world and countless others.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter0_set.6: I am surprised to see you here... yet, it can't just be a coincidence.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter0_set.7: I believe you are a kindhearted soul, sent here to rescue this tiny world.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter0_set.8: But I must warn you, every world, every dimension, have been haunted by a one and only being : him.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter0_set.9: He is capable of taking different forms, of adapting and corrupting everything he touches, world after the other.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter0_set.10: You must be a lone survivor of his cruelty... as all traces of humanity has disappeared from this world.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter0_set.11: [weakly] Lies. Ignore this voice, she is manipulating you.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter0_set.12: Leave, now. Come back when armed, when you have fought the first manifestations of his hatred.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter0_set.13: Come back with an iron sword. I'll explain your mission in due time, if you so choose to help us.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter_1_ask.t: Are you ready for your first sealing ?
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter1_set.1: You're back... I do hope, it's not to do anything stupid.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter1.set.2: You know, I never intended to do any harm.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter1_set.3: I just tried to save many worlds in the best way I know. If you listen to me, you'll realise that-
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter1_set.4: You're here, and you've succeeded. Good.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter1_set.5: In this world, the sword we create are all enchanted with an ancient magic.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter1_set.6: Thanks to these, you'll be able to seal the Scourge. He his already partially sealed, but slowly that seal is weakening.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter1_set.7: The only way to save this world, is to seal the original version of the Scourge, the most powerful one.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter1_yes_se: Great, the seal is holding one... well for now at least.
Your next mission will be to craft a diamond sword.
You'll need different materials: gold, emerald and amethyst.
For now, focus on the world you reside in : the Overworld.
You'll visit other dimensions once you have better equipment.
And if you desire... maybe you could rebuild the lost civilisation.
Build a village, and when it is ready, I will breath new life into it.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter1_no_set: I see. Come back when ready.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter2_set.1: You're here. And you've managed to banish his followers, I know it wasn't easy, but-
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter2_set.2: Useless, it's all useless. These seals, there just ridiculous toys.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter2_set.3: She only seeks to gain an advantage over me, to steal my powers. I have never done anything wrong.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter2_set.4: I only want to live and I'm just defending myself, just like the ones she calls my followers.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter2_set.5: The only ones who truly kill is her... and who, her devoted puppet.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter_2_ask.t: Are you ready for the sealing ?
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter2_yes_se: Useless, everything you're doing is useless.
His hold on the different worlds is weakening.
It is due time to explore what lies beyond the Overworld.
Two places of interest : the Nether, realm of flames, and the Deepwaters, endless submarine caves.
In those two dimensions you will find foes to defeat and precious resources to gather.
It is your new mission. However do not forget the Overworld, it is still infested with wicked souls
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter2_no_set: Take the time to think it over.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.1: You have killed my Leviathan, my pet. And you've also stolen its offspring.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.2: It's pure evil. You're so cruel. When will this stop ?
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.3: I swear, you'll pay for this. If you so dare to stop me, at least know that it is simply impossible.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.4: From now on, I will send my most powerful followers. My Seven Deadly Sins.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.5: They will make you suffer until the end of you're miserable life. Enjoy the rest-
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.6: Stop listening to him. They are nothing more than just pitiful spectres.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.7: Dangerous, yes, yet they are not that different from the ones you have already defeated.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.8: Your next target is one of his most powerful manifestations : the Ender Dragon.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.9: To reach him, you'll need the twelve Eyes.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.10: He made your task much easier my summoning his Deadly Sins. They should all bear a fragment.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.11: You should also visit the Moon, where undead hide from the light of the sun.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.12: Then tread deep into the caves, into the Otherside, to confront dark and terrifying creatures.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.13: Finally you should defeat Gaïa's Gardian, to prove to everyone, yourself included, that you have become much more powerful.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_ask.te: Are you ready to seal him again ?
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_yes_se: All that journey... to upgrade what you already had.
Forge all these elements into something truly supreme.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_no_set: Don't make us wait too long. His followers are waiting for you.
